summary: Tested Filter Harga Cabang (branch prices on cards, sort, price range and facets). I did NOT call /admin/branch-copy/*/apply. For the tests I wrote temporary prices straight into 5 pgs-jombang store_stock rows (pgs-45768, pgs-9849 and pgs-9955 at Sidoarjo price +2000, pgs-9952 = 99,999,999, pgs-13018 = 1) and removed them afterwards. Final check: store_stock count_documents({'price': {'$exists': true}}) == 0. BACKEND: 17/17 new pytest tests pass. With X-Store-Id pgs-jombang, cards on the home, search and category lists and on the detail page show the branch price. price_asc and price_desc follow the branch price (Rp1 is first ascending, 99,999,999 first descending, pagination is consistent). min_price/max_price filter on the branch price (min_price=99999990 returns only pgs-9952 in Jombang and [] for pgs-official and pgs-jember). Combined category, brand, in_stock and range filters work. Facets use the branch price for price_min/max (1 to 99,999,999), and total, brands and categories follow the range. Home sections and recommendations show the branch price. pgs-official and pgs-jember are unchanged. A product with grosir tiers (branch tier_prices set) also shows correct prices. Timing: Jombang price sort ~0.45s, facets ~0.45s, Sidoarjo ~0.1s. The iter45 regression suite passes (18/18). FRONTEND (390px, localStorage pgs_store_id=pgs-jombang, manual=1, geolocation set to Jombang): Beranda cards, the Katalog tab (Harga termurah / Harga termahal and the filter sheet range with min 99.999.990 -> 1 product, the sheet hint 'Harga di hasil ini: Rp99.999.999') and in-app navigation Beranda -> Dapur category -> product detail all show Jombang prices. 2 frontend bugs found: (1) if a category or product page is the first page loaded (reload, deep link or shared link), its first request is sent with X-Store-Id pgs-official, so Sidoarjo prices show; (2) screens that stay open (Katalog tab, category, product detail) do not reload when the buyer changes branch, so they keep the old branch's prices.

minor.issue: Sort and range use the base price (branch price or product price). Logged-in pengecer/reseller buyers see the tier price for their own type (my_price) on the card, so the order and range can look slightly off for them. This already happened before the change for Sidoarjo too; it is not a regression.

integration_issues.flow: Cold load / deep link of /category/[id] and /product/[id]
integration_issues.issue: The first api.products / api.product request is sent with X-Store-Id pgs-official, before StoreProvider has read pgs_store_id from AsyncStorage (store-context.tsx starts with useState('pgs-official')). These screens do not depend on storeId, so they never fetch again. Seen: /category/peralatan-masak showed pgs-9849 at Rp167.000 (Sidoarjo) instead of Rp169.000; /product/pgs-9849 showed Rp167.000. Reaching the same screens in-app from Beranda shows the right Jombang price. Reference: app/category/[id].tsx:37-42 (deps [id, sort]); product detail screen fetch. Captured request: 'REQ /api/products/pgs-9849 X-Store-Id= pgs-official'.

integration_issues.flow: Switching branch (store-switch -> pick-store-pgs-official) while the Katalog tab is open
integration_issues.issue: In search.tsx the fetch effect depends only on [q, sort, filters], so the Katalog tab keeps showing the previous branch's prices after a switch. Seen: after switching to Sidoarjo, the Katalog tab still showed Casserole Rp215.000 and Dutch Oven Rp99.999.999 (Jombang). Beranda reloads correctly. The category and product detail screens have the same gap when they stay in the stack. Reference: app/search.tsx:40-49, app/category/[id].tsx:37-42.

action_items: Category, product detail and search/Katalog screens: get storeId and ready from useStore(), skip fetching until ready === true, and add storeId to the fetch effect deps (category/[id].tsx:37, search.tsx:40, the product detail fetch, and the facets fetch in the filter sheet). This makes deep links/reloads use the chosen branch and makes the screens reload after a branch switch.
Optional: say in the Katalog/Kategori sort labels or tooltip that sort and range use the base (eceran) branch price, not the tier price for pengecer/reseller.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _branch_price_stages runs a $lookup into store_stock for every matched product (about 6.6k) on each price sort, range-facet or facets call. Measured ~0.45s; the store_product index keeps it fast, but cost grows with catalog size. Consider caching or denormalising if the catalog grows past ~20k.

In the price_asc/price_desc aggregate path, list_products skips the in-page 'in stock first' re-sort (correct). Variant products are excluded from branch_prices and from branch-copy, but _branch_price_stages would still use a store_stock price on a variant product if one was ever written manually. Low risk.

_catalog_query price range: products whose branch price is out of range are excluded through $nin of every branch-priced id. Once all ~6.6k rows have prices (after Terapkan), this sends large $in/$nin lists in every range query; it works, but the same _bp aggregate could be used instead.

success_rate.frontend: ~70% (Beranda, Katalog sort and range, in-app category and detail correct; cold deep-link category/detail and stale Katalog after branch switch wrong)

seed_data_creation: Temporary prices only, set directly in db.store_stock for 5 pgs-jombang rows (the pytest fixture sets and unsets its own picks; /tmp/bp.py was used for the UI run). All removed; verified store_stock price rows == 0. Card ranges like 'Rp138.240 - Rp99.999.999' and 'Hemat Rp99.861.759' in screenshots came from these temp prices (Sidoarjo tier_prices were left in place) and are not app bugs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the backend file with -n 0 (pytest.ini turns on xdist; a module fixture under xdist races between workers). Never run test_branch_copy.py apply or test_pgs_iter17 (it mutates data and is missing an env var). To check the frontend fix: with localStorage pgs_store_id=pgs-jombang and temp prices set, cold-load /category/peralatan-masak and /product/pgs-9849 and check that the request header is X-Store-Id pgs-jombang. Then switch branch via store-switch and check that the Katalog tab reloads.
rca_of_issue: StoreProvider starts with storeId 'pgs-official' and reads AsyncStorage in an effect. api.ts sets the X-Store-Id header from currentStore. Screens mounted on first render (deep link) fetch at once, before hydration, and their effects do not depend on storeId, so they never fetch again. Repro: open /category/peralatan-masak directly with pgs_store_id=pgs-jombang -> request header pgs-official -> Sidoarjo prices. Fix: gate on ready and add storeId to deps.
